item.text:
Added a sixth finding in the exposed test harness. `EnsureSamePeers` captures the expected configuration once and never refreshes it, causing false failures when raft 0 initially trails a membership change.

This explains the shuffled-suite failure in `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_2_3`, which failed 6 times in 20 isolated runs. A separate catch-up diagnostic confirmed that all nodes eventually reached the correct three-server configuration.
